question: Who among the following has been awarded the Padma Shri for his extensive contribution to Mohiniyattam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanak Rele.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kanak Rele**, who has been awarded the **Padma Shri** for her extensive contribution to **Mohiniyattam.**

 
 
• She is a renowned Mohiniyattam dancer and choreographer who has contributed significantly to the development and popularization of this dance form.
 
• She has also** founded the Nalanda Dance Research Centre in Mumbai**, which is dedicated to the research and preservation of Indian classical dance forms.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam **is a **classical Indian dance form from Kerala**, which is known for its graceful movements and expressions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **K P Kittappa Pillai** is a well-known **Carnatic musician and composer** who has composed several popular songs and ragas. 

 
 
• He is known for his innovative approach to music and has won several awards for his contributions to the field.
 
 
 
• **Mehboob Subhani **is a **social activist and educationist** who has worked towards the **empowerment of the marginalized communities in India**. 
 
 
• He has **founded several schools and educational institutions** to provide quality education to children from underprivileged backgrounds.
 
 
 
• **Suchitra Ella** is a** scientist and entrepreneur** who has made significant **contributions to the fields of biotechnology and healthcare. **
 
 
• She is the **co-founder of a biotech company** that specializes in developing vaccines and other healthcare products.​
